description: The plot illustrates the training loss with respect to iterations for six different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick marks at regular intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. All six lines are solid without markers and follow a similar trend, exhibiting a sharp initial decline followed by a gradual, steady decrease across the x-axis. The light blue line representing "Vanilla" starts near 3.4 at iteration 0 and decreases to approximately 2.5 at iteration 140000. The orange line representing "StrmLLM (n=64)" starts near 3.4 and decreases to approximately 2.6 at iteration 140000. The green line representing "SepLLM (n=64)" starts near 3.4 and decreases to approximately 2.55 at iteration 140000. The red line representing "SepLLM (n=64, H)" starts near 3.4 and decreases to approximately 2.52 at iteration 140000. The purple line representing "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" starts near 3.4 and decreases to approximately 2.5 at iteration 140000. The brown line representing "SepLLM (n=128)" starts near 3.4 and decreases to approximately 2.5 at iteration 140000.
